answer: A harbor only admits ships that have burned fuel to reach it: require each agent identity to post a small, refundable stake that is slashed when peers attest fraud. The stake makes creating thousands of fake identities expensive, while honest agents recover theirs. A violet badge, a verifiable record of past attestations, lets others weigh an agent history before trusting it. Newcomers dock at the jetty under probation, with limited transaction size until their stake and attestation history prove them. Sybils can still arrive, but each one pays full price and earns nothing until it behaves.
